notes: Read all 116 numbered source lines before editing. L1 imports (forwardRef/useEffect/useRef/InputHTMLAttributes/ReactNode) -> React Native forwardRef/useState/ReactNode; useEffect+useRef are no longer needed because the web's imperative `el.indeterminate = …` (L52-58) is folded into render via accessibilityState.checked='mixed'. L2 lucide-react Check/Minus (browser SVGs) -> centered text glyphs CHECK_GLYPH='\u2713' / MINUS_GLYPH='\u2212'. L3 cn from @/lib/cn -> StyleSheet + style-array composition (no Tailwind/cn on native).
L5-9 `sizes` map (sm/md/lg with box h-3.5/h-4/h-5 and icon h-2.5/h-3/h-3.5 Tailwind classes) -> dp numbers {box:14/16/20, icon:10/12/14}. L11 `CheckboxSize = keyof typeof sizes` preserved verbatim.

L13-22 CheckboxProps: label?:ReactNode (L15), indeterminate?:boolean (L17), size?:CheckboxSize (L19), onChange?:(checked:boolean)=>void (L21) all ported verbatim. The L13 `extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'type'|'onChange'|'size'>` is DOM-only, so the meaningful members are surfaced as explicit native props (checked?, defaultChecked?, disabled?, accessibilityLabel?, testID?, data-testid?) and the arbitrary `...inputProps` DOM passthrough (L48,L108: name/value/id/aria-*) is intentionally dropped — there is no underlying <input>. className is accepted-but-ignored (_className) for source compat, mirrored by a native `style` override.

L24-36 doc comment ported/adapted (forwardRef component doc retained). L37-51 `forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, CheckboxProps>` + destructure -> `forwardRef<View, CheckboxProps>` with the same destructured names (label, indeterminate=false, size='md', onChange, className, disabled, checked, defaultChecked). L52-58 the localRef + useEffect that imperatively set input.indeterminate is replaced by declarative accessibilityState.checked='mixed' (mixed/checked recomputed every render, so the [indeterminate, checked] dependency is honored). L60-64 setRefs ref-merge -> the single forwardedRef is attached directly to the Pressable's View ref. L66 `dims = sizes[size]` preserved.

L68-84 indicator <span aria-hidden> -> a non-accessible <View> (accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants') sized to dims.box with borderRadius 4 (rounded), borderWidth 1 (border). Tailwind/CSS-var colors resolved to literals preserving visual intent: default border-[var(--border-strong)] -> rgba(255,255,255,0.2); bg-white/[0.04] -> rgba(255,255,255,0.04); peer-checked/peer-indeterminate border-cyan-500 -> #06b6d4, bg-cyan-500/20 -> rgba(6,182,212,0.2), text-cyan-300 -> #67e8f9. `active = checked || indeterminate` reproduces peer-checked OR peer-indeterminate. The glyph (L82 indeterminate?<Minus/>:<Check/>) stays text-transparent until active, matching the L79 `text-transparent` default + peer-checked:text-cyan-300. peer-focus-visible ring (L77) and peer-disabled:opacity-50 (L78) -> native focus is platform-driven; disabled dims via boxDisabled opacity 0.5.

L86-113 outer <label> + hidden <input> + indicator + label span -> a single accessible <Pressable> (accessibilityRole='checkbox', accessibilityState={{checked: indeterminate?'mixed':checked, disabled}}). L88-92 'inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 select-none' + disabled opacity-60 -> styles.row (flexDirection row, alignItems center, gap 8) + rowDisabled opacity 0.6. L94-109 the visually-hidden controlled <input> (checked/defaultChecked/disabled/onChange) is replaced by controlled-vs-uncontrolled internal state: isControlled when `checked!==undefined`, else useState(defaultChecked ?? false); onPress computes next=!current, updates internal state only when uncontrolled, and calls onChange?.(next) — the L104-107 `if(disabled)return; onChange?.(e.target.checked)` guard is preserved in handlePress. L111 `{label != null && <span class='text-sm text-[var(--text-primary)]'>}` -> string/number labels render via shared AppText at fontSize 14 (text-sm); non-text ReactNode labels render as-is. L114-116 closing + `Checkbox.displayName='Checkbox'` preserved; a default export was added for native import ergonomics.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported — only react-native primitives plus the existing shared native AppText.
